weekender.context: Full-grain leather flap, rolled handles, and trim over tightly woven heavyweight canvas. Structured top-handle silhouette scaled for travel, with a working turn-lock, belted clasp straps, and reinforced leather corners. NO ZIPPER anywhere. Opens wide via the rigid frame, packs like a suitcase not a duffel. UGC generation uses the MEDIUM size (16in W x 13in H x 6.5in D, overnight trip / oversized everyday carry) — do not depict Medium-Large or Large capacity claims (two to three days of clothing) against this size.

fits an overnight trip or oversized everyday carry (medium size)
claims_banned: ANY origin claim (Italian, French, European, American leather or craftsmanship)
the word Birkin spoken or on screen
zipper / unzip / zips (this bag has no zipper — turn-lock and belt straps only)
Medium-Large/Large capacity claims (two to three days of clothing) shown against the Medium size

colette.title: The Colette Wool Tote
colette.offer: PRE-ORDER. $149.99, regular $189.99, save $40. Ships early October (supplier placeholder, confirm before any run states it).
colette.context: Oatmeal brushed wool felt tote, 50 x 26 x 18 cm, belted in caramel or espresso leather. Angle: fits everything, does not look like it. The wool body is the only thing that gets to this size and still reads like something she would wear.
colette.geometry_lock: Trapezoid tote, wider at the top, flat base, stands upright unaided. Exactly 2 handles, each caramel leather on the upper arc and oatmeal wool on the lower legs. The legs continue down the FRONT face as exactly 2 vertical wool straps. Exactly 1 leather belt runs horizontally across the FRONT face, passes behind both vertical straps, and its 2 ends curve downward and outward, each terminating in exactly 1 round gold disc cap. 2 disc caps total, and they are the ONLY hardware. Open top. No flap, no zipper, no closure, no logo, no lettering.
claims_ok: Loro Piana inspired (Brooks 2026-08-04, taste anchor only, must cash straight into a physical feature)
fits a laptop, a water bottle and a sweater

any claim that the belt adjusts, cinches or gives two looks (unverified on the physical sample)
